a: وَلَمَّا بَرَزُوا۟ لِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَفْرِغْ عَلَيْنَا صَبْرًا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
p: Rabbanā afrigh ʿalaynā ṣabran wa thabbit aqdāmanā wa-nṣurnā ʿala-l-qawmi-l-kāfirīn.
m: And when they went forth to [face] Goliath and his soldiers, they said, "Our Lord, pour upon us patience and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people."
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
